findings.practical_consequence: A planner could replace the universal directives and four mode playbooks while leaving the verification skills governed by old or duplicated approval, remediation, and scope rules, so the promoted system could still produce contradictory behavior through verify-plan, verify-analysis, or verify-work.
evidence: Tasks/directive-system-vnext/research-v3/charter.json explicitly includes verification skill contracts insofar as they duplicate or operationalize directive obligations.
skills/plan-playbook/SKILL.md delegates plan hardening to verify-plan, while skills/review-playbook/SKILL.md delegates iterative work to verify-analysis and verify-work.

Tasks/directive-system-vnext/research-v3/work/candidate-round-2.json inventories ownership only for research-playbook, plan-playbook, write-code-playbook, review-playbook, and reproduce-first-verify; its evidence index and adoption contract do not inspect, disposition, assign ownership for, or validate the named verification skill contracts.
